title: 30,000 Facebook Accounts Hacked via Google AppSheet Phishing Campaign
summary:

title: Top Five Sales Challenges Costing MSPs Cybersecurity Revenue
summary:

title: Two Cybersecurity Professionals Get 4-Year Sentences in BlackCat Ransomware Attacks
summary:
The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) on Thursday announced the sentencing of two cybersecurity professionals to four years each in prison for their role in facilitating BlackCat ransomware attacks in 2023.
Ryan Goldberg, 40, of Georgia, and Kevin Martin, 36, of Texas, were accused of deploying the ransomware against multiple victims located throughout the U.S.
